source_title: From Artist-Approved Headphones to Diamonds and Decor, Here Are 18 Luxury Gifts Worth Giving This Year
source_excerpt:
If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, Rolling Stone may receive an affiliate commission.
A thoughtful gift doesn’t have to be an expensive one, but there’s nothing wrong with splurging a little for someone you care about. A quality gift for a loved one (or even yourself) can be a special way to add a little magic year-round.
Whether you’re shopping for someone who appreciates the finer things, or you just want an extra-special way to show you care, we’ve rounded up the best luxury gifts you can buy online.
Here are our picks for the best luxury gifts for anyone you want to spoil a little (or a lot). We sorted through high-end offerings to find picks from brands we’ve tested and can vouch for — as well as items on our own wishlists.
Sony 1000X THE COLLEXION Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones
The latest Sony headphones are also the best headphones the legendary audio company has ever released, thanks to a bespoke driver tuned by Grammy-winning engineers , incredible noise canceling that you can feel as soon as you put the earpads on, and a 360 Reality Audio Upmix feature, which automatically elevates what you’re listening to into an immersive surround sound-style experience. But what truly makes these headphones luxurious is their sleek and sculpted design, with supple vegan leather and bold metallic accents combining to create a piece that looks as good as it sounds.
Bang & Olufsen Beoplay H100 Active Noise Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones
Take your listening game up a notch further with these headphones from iconic Scandinavian audio manufacturer Bang & Olufsen. These Beoplay H100 headphones feature a soft-knit headband and cushy memory foam earcups, wrapped in sumptuous leather with aluminum accents. The state of the art craftsmanship extends to the audio, with 40mm titanium drivers and B&O’s “most advanced” active noise cancellation technology yet. Need more convincing to pick up a pair of Beoplays? Felix from Stray Kids has posted multiple photos of him wearing these headphones while traveling on tour.
Bose’s new Lifestyle Ultra Speaker is designed for exactly that — to easily fit into any space or style with its minimalist and unpretentious design. The wireless speaker comes in this “white smoke” colorway or a matte black and offers an elegant way to listen to music at home. Everything pairs easily via WiFi, Bluetooth, AirPlay, Spotify, or Google Cast, and you can also control settings and songs using your voice with Alexa. Our recommendation: pair two of these speakers together in one gift, to deliver a multi-room listening experience for your recipient.
Solitaire Oval Opal Criss Cross Ring with Diamonds
Few rings have made us do a double take quite like this “criss cross” ring from Angara, which features an elegant oval opal surrounded by diamond accents. Everything is wrapped in 14k rose gold, with a design inspired by the “XOXO” sign off for love. Rings are no longer reserved for anniversaries or engagements — this one shines bright as a holiday gift or as an anytime “I love you” reminder too. Each piece is accompanied by a certificate of authenticity and comes with a branded black box and bag for easy gifting.
Dior’s luxurious creme gelée is designed to adapt to every skin type to deeply hydrate, visibly plump, and reveal a more radiant complexion. Made in France and inspired by caviar beads, It’s a self-care essential that makes a showstopping upgrade for anyone who takes skincare seriously. What we like: the formula is gentle enough for all skin types, while the beautifully-designed jar makes for a great #shelfie pic.
You really can’t go wrong with a shearling mule or bootie in the winter — and this pair from Prada is the perfect version of this winter wardrobe staple. Made in Italy shoe features a genuine leather upper with shearling lining, as well as a platform sole, making it ideal for braving winter weather while running errands, or staying cozy at home.
SuitShop Dark Green Double Breasted Tuxedo Jacket
Few things are as luxurious (or treasured) as a custom made outfit, and SuitShop offers made-to-order tuxedos and suits that can be ordered online. Choose from a wide variety of colors, prints, patterns and silhouettes, and have your dream suit sewn to your specifications. This is a great gift for a special occasion (like a wedding or anniversary), but also an opportunity to gift the men in your life a go-to suit for galas, cocktail functions or an everyday suit for work. SuitShop says their made-to-order model is also more sustainable than buying premade suit sets online — with SuitShop, you make exactly what you want and only what you want, ensuring there is no waste from overproduction.
If your gift recipient is a fragrance fanatic and already has an expansive collection, Miu Miu’s Miutine is a great option. The new floral fragrance has key notes of strawberry, gardenia, brown sugar, and vanilla, making it fresh, light, and feminine. I’ve been wearing it daily, and it has a long-lasting scent that doesn’t feel overpowering. The bottle is also striking, making it a stylish addition to any bathroom vanity. This gift sets features a 10ml travel-size and a 100ml bottle, beautifully presented in a Miu Miu-branded box.
Polo Ralph Lauren’s bear sweater is an iconic gift for the preppy type. There are so many options of bears to choose from, from the Tweed Bear to the Painter Bear (and even this bow tie bear seen here), making the sweater something of a collectible. Macy’s has styles and sizes for both men and women available here .
With a burn time of approximately 90 hours, you can’t go wrong with gifting this Le Labo candle in fan-favorite scent Santal 26. This concrete candle is a limited edition (with a special black version only available on Le Labo’s official site ) and will last your gift recipient throughout the cold winter season. It’s a standout display piece for your home too, whether on a table or shelf.
Ariana Grande’s Swarovski capsule collection features sparkling music-inspired motifs , hearts, and pearls, making each piece the perfect add-on to an outfit to polish your look. The entire collection can be dressed up or down for any occasion and is a great gift idea for music fans and accessory collectors alike. This one seen here is made from rhodium-plated, heart-shaped crystals, but you can shop more picks — including bracelets, earrings and charms — at Swarovski.com .
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Paris Baccarat Rouge 540
Fragrances can be tricky to buy as gifts, but Baccarat Rouge 540 by Maison Francis Kurkdjian Paris widely beloved for a reason with a one-of-a-kind scent that’s both woody and floral, at once fresh and intense. The official olfactory notes include jasmine, saffron and moss, but it all combines into an intoxicating scent that’s instantly memorably but virtually untraceable. In other words, you’ll have everyone coming up to you to ask, “What are you wearing?”
Coach’s Chelsea Shoulder Bag went viral in 2026 and for all the right reasons: its slouchy shape, supple leather construction and minimalist design make this unisex bag a fit for basically anything and anyone. Pack the bag for work, for example, or use it as your airplane personal item when traveling. A large interior capacity and a zip pocket make organization easy, while the adjustable strap lets you sling this over your shoulder or wear it as a messenger.
This classic shoe from Maison Margiela, inspired by the 1970s, has stood the test of time and is a great sneaker staple for anyone’s collection. They are stylish but also comfortable and can be dressed up or down, making them truly versatile. While Black and White are classic colors, a handful of fun colors like Cloud and Boero have been added to the lineup if you’re looking for a pop. For sneakerheads on your gifting list, this is an easy way to elevate their footwear game.
Acne Studios Vally Plaid Alpaca, Wool & Mohair Blend Scarf
Scarves are a gifting staple but think beyond basic plaid this year. Acne Studios scarves have become a stylish pick for fall and winter over the years and are an easy way to elevate an outfit without much effort. Crafted with an alpaca, wool and mohair blend, this scarf can be pulled out year after year while retaining incredible softness and warmth. It also comes in a few fun colorways that add a pop of color while still being simple enough to be paired with any look.
Assouline Formula 1: The Impossible Collection 2nd Edition Hardcover Book
Few sports have taken off in recent years quite like F1 , and this Formula 1 book from Assouline features luxe packaging and impressive photography tracing history-making moments on and off the track. The book is even scented with notes of rubber, making it a one-of-a-kind gift and an ultimate coffee table display piece.
Baies is a crowd-favorite scent from French fragrance house Diptyque and this hourglass diffuser makes a great gift because it combines form and function. It’s a stylish addition to any room and can keep your space smelling fresh and welcoming for guests, while offering an art-inspired alternative to burning a candle.
Balenciaga always finds a way to put its own stamp on luxury (pun intended), and this passport holder is no exception. A great luxury travel gift, the passport holder is also an unexpected gift for someone who is always on the go. There are four card slots and a flat pocket to keep you organized as you (hopefully) breeze through the airport with that other ultimate luxury: a first-class ticket.
